footprint.http_elapsed_basis: Sum of measured HTTP opening and response-body read; includes connection setup and response headers but does not separate their time. Body-byte counts exclude header bytes. Excludes local analysis/extraction and tool/harness work outside requests.
footprint.unavailable_reason: No authoritative model, token or billing telemetry exposed to this analyst.

scope_note: Two preselected operator studies, one record and one paper each. Audit of operator reports, not replication of private operational data. No discovery search, outreach, experiment or extra source. Short located paraphrases <=150 words per source across retained evidence; evidence files contain only cross-references.
source_body_policy: Full bodies are temporary verifier caches only, absent from the repository. Temporary paths name local handoff locations and are not replayable public evidence. The S03 HTML cache was redacted after evidence review; original-byte hashes stay unchanged.
collection_clock_basis: collected_utc and evidence read_utc are gate/collection-procedure start, not exact substantive-read time; individual substantive request and completion clocks are in reads-iteration-2.jsonl.
